name: Melissa B.
bio: Melissa has a Bachelor’s Degree in Archaeology with a specialization in Forensics and enjoyed a successful 15 year career in Sales & Customer Service before deciding to become a Professional Dog Trainer in 2021. She brings 17 years of animal training and competition experience with horses in dressage. She grew up with dogs, has done agility training and earned Canine Good Citizen & Canine Good Neighbour titles. She currently competes actively with her dog Luna and most recently earned her novice and intermediate titles in rally-obedience.
